How to read this

One agent: agent λ runs the Claude tool loop; every other Lambda is plain Python or a single structured Claude call.

Schedules (Europe/London): ingest 07:00 and 21:00 · briefs 07:15 and 21:15 on weekdays · news every 3 h · score 23:30 · Saturday review 08:00.

Numbers come from code; Claude writes the words. Nothing is saved without a Confirm tap. The bot cannot trade.

Each member has their own chat, accounts and preferences; the household view is a sum.

Two environments, dev and prod, same shape, separate bots and budgets.
